editorial:
The Monster and the Ape is a 15-chapter Columbia serial released on 20 April 1945. Howard Bretherton directed and Rudolph C. Flothow produced. Robert Lowery, George Macready and Ralph Morgan appear in the cast, and Ray Corrigan is credited as Thor, a trained ape (source: Wikipedia, The Monster and the Ape).

The Catalog of Copyright Entries for 1972 records a renewal by Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. (R530837, filed 14 June 1972) for Chapter 1, 'The Mechanical Terror'. Only that Chapter 1 entry has been confirmed. Renewals for Chapters 2-15 have not been checked, so the status of the serial as a whole, and of the other chapters, is open. Free copies online are not evidence of clearance. Until each chapter is checked, do not assume any chapter is free to reuse.
faq: Is The Monster and the Ape (1945) in the public domain?

Undetermined. The 1972 Catalog of Copyright Entries lists a renewal by Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. (R530837, 14 June 1972) for Chapter 1, 'The Mechanical Terror'. Renewals for Chapters 2-15 have not been checked. Copies on video sites do not make any chapter free to reuse.
Can I use clips from the serial in my own video?

Only with a licence or a solid fair-use position. Short clips for commentary or criticism may qualify as fair use. Reusing whole chapters needs a clearance check for each chapter, or permission from the rights holder.
